correctness.rationale: Reconstructed exact independent Poisson-age OU maximum kernel R_{j+1}=exp(-kE/r)R_j+sqrt((D/k)(1-exp(-2kE/r)))M_N, with stationary contractive perpetuity. Beta-integral first and second moment equations give m_r=c_N sqrt(r)+O(r^-1/2) and v_r->(D/k)(nu_N-pi mu_N^2/4). Centered innovations have L2 limit H=sqrt(2DE)M_N-kc_NE; calculate variance 2D(nu_N-pi mu_N^2/4). Martingale triangular-array predictable variance and fourth moments yield Gaussian law, tail controlled; ordinary-time all-coordinate difference O_P(r^-1/2). Independent exact N=2 evaluation at D=1.7,k=.9,r=250: m=16.2116725068, variance=1.41624243337 versus limit 1.41666666667. Finite test is corroboration only.
